children: Hamid Khoja, Chief Scientific Officer of FibroBiologics, Inc., acquired a 7.5% stake in FibroBiologics’ common stock. The stake reflects a Sept. 15, 2026 private placement of 298,508 shares with accompanying warrants, disclosed in a Schedule 13D filed Sep. 17, 2026. The deal adds immediate capital and gives Khoja warrants exercisable at $1.55 for five years.

Khoja bought the shares "in support of the Issuer's business plan and for investment purposes." He may buy or sell more stock over time and holds warrants for 298,508 shares that he can exercise at any time; he also holds employee stock options but has no other agreements to acquire additional common stock.
As Chief Scientific Officer, Khoja takes part in material business decisions at FibroBiologics. He did not outline plans for board changes, control shifts, or other corporate actions in this filing.

Hamid Khoja is an American scientist and executive who serves as Chief Scientific Officer of FibroBiologics, Inc., a clinical-stage biotechnology company based in Houston, Texas. He focuses on advancing fibroblast-based cell therapies and related regenerative medicine programs. As an operator-investor, he concentrates his holdings in his employer’s equity and incentive awards aligned with company milestones.
